# langfuse_model (Resource)

Manage a custom model definition (name matching and pricing) in a project using project-scoped credentials. Set either the flat prices (input_price, output_price, total_price) or pricing_tiers, not both. Langfuse-managed built-in models cannot be modified or deleted through the API and cannot be managed by this resource. Import format: project_public_key:project_secret_key:model_id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "project_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Flat prices per unit.
resource "langfuse_model" "flat" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  model_name         = "internal-llm"
  match_pattern      = "(?i)^(internal-llm)$"
  unit               = "TOKENS"
  input_price        = 0.000001
  output_price       = 0.000002
}

# Tiered prices: usage above 200k input tokens is billed at a higher rate.
resource "langfuse_model" "tiered" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  model_name         = "internal-llm-long-context"
  match_pattern      = "(?i)^(internal-llm-long-context)$"
  start_date         = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
  unit               = "TOKENS"
  tokenizer_id       = "openai"
  tokenizer_config = jsonencode({
    tokenizerModel   = "gpt-4o"
    tokensPerMessage = 3
    tokensPerName    = 1
  })
  pricing_tiers = jsonencode([
    {
      name       = "Standard"
      isDefault  = true
      priority   = 0
      conditions = []
      prices     = { input = 0.000001, output = 0.000002 }
    },
    {
      name      = "Long context"
      isDefault = false
      priority  = 1
      conditions = [{
        usageDetailPattern = "input"
        operator           = "gt"
        value              = 200000
        caseSensitive      = false
      }]
      prices = { input = 0.000002, output = 0.000004 }
    },
  ])
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `match_pattern` (String) Regular expression matched against the model name of ingested generations, for example `(?i)^(gpt-4o)$`.
- `model_name` (String) Name of the model definition. Usage is attributed to the newest definition whose match_pattern matches.
- `project_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The project public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.
- `unit` (String) Unit of usage. Valid values: CHARACTERS, TOKENS, MILLISECONDS, SECONDS, IMAGES, REQUESTS.

### Optional

- `input_price` (Number) Price in USD per input unit.
- `output_price` (Number) Price in USD per output unit.
- `pricing_tiers` (String) Pricing tiers as a JSON array string. Each tier has name, isDefault, priority, conditions, and prices. Exactly one tier must be the default tier with priority 0 and no conditions.
- `start_date` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp from which this definition applies. Omit to apply it to all generations.
- `tokenizer_config` (String) Tokenizer configuration as a JSON object string.
- `tokenizer_id` (String) Tokenizer used to count tokens when usage is not ingested. Valid values: openai, claude.
- `total_price` (Number) Price in USD per total unit. Cannot be combined with input_price or output_price.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the model.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langfuse_model.example "${PROJECT_PUBLIC_KEY}:${PROJECT_SECRET_KEY}:${MODEL_ID}"
```
